snippet.title: Know Your Ánima – Official Launch Trailer | Out October 28 on Steam
snippet.description:
Know Your Ánima launches October 28 on Steam. Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4249010/

A cozy farming sim that gets to know you back.

Tend a dreamlike inner garden over 12 days and nights. Plant, water, harvest and open up new corners of your garden, answer the letters that find their way to your mailbox, and talk with the spirit animals who come to visit. Everything you do, and everything you don't, quietly shapes your story.

When the cycle ends, a card-reveal ceremony unveils your Ánima archetype, led by the Ánima that defines you the most. There is no game over and no single way to play: the garden simply reflects what you bring to it.

🌱 16 crops in 4 families
✉️ Letters, visitors and choices that are yours alone
🎴 12 Ánimas, 24 facets to discover
🌙 Day and night cycles, and rain that slowly soaks the soil
🌍 8 languages: English, Español, Português (Brasil), Italiano, Deutsch, 简体中文, 한국어, 日本語

Don't lie to yourself. Be who you are.


―――――――――――――
